map.计算旅行总天数，或者距离出发还有多久: Calculate the total number of trip days, or how long until departure
map.行程天数 =（返回日期 − 出发日期）÷ 86400000 + 1（含首尾两天）: Trip days = (return date − departure date) ÷ 86400000 + 1 (counting both endpoints); nights = days − 1; countdown to departure = ceil(departure date − current date). Months and years are accumulated automatically by timestamp, and a leap-year February adds one day; days elapsed = current date − departure date.

map.start 设 9/10、now 9/1，untilStart=ceil((st: With start set to 9/10 and now at 9/1, untilStart = ceil((start − now)/86400000) = 9 days, which is useful for pre-trip planning.

map.含，end−start 毫秒加 1 天；nights=days−1 为过夜数。: Yes. One day is added to the milliseconds difference between end and start, and nights = days − 1 gives the number of overnight stays.
